options.name: add_ip_addresses
options.description: IP addresses to add to the current list. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Name of the DNS domain, where the NAS Server does host names lookup when an FQDN is not specified in the request.

options.name: file_dns_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the file DNS.

options.name: is_destination_override_enabled
options.description: In order to modify any properties of this resource when the associated NAS server is a replication destination, the I(is_destination_override_enabled) flag must be set to C(true).

options.name: nas_server
options.description: Unique identifier/name of the associated NAS Server instance that uses this DNS Service object.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: remove_ip_addresses
options.description: IP addresses to remove from the current list. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the file DNS should be enabled or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: transport
options.description: Transport used when connecting to the DNS Server. C(UDP) - DNS uses the UDP protocol. C(TCP) - DNS uses the TCP protocol.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
